Who we are
We are responsible for development, operation, and management of a Shucle platform, a Mobility as a Service (MaaS) solution utilizing smart technology.
We handle all aspects of planning, development, data analysis, service operations, and business development for the community-based demand-responsive transportation service, and we work directly on these tasks to ensure agility and focus on both customers and service enhancement.
Our goal is to create a service that embodies the abstract concept of MaaS, enabling everyone to move freely in their daily lives.
Shucle (https://www.shucle.com) was introduced in 2020 as South Korea's first urban demand-responsive transportation service utilizing AI technology. Since then, it has become the number one community mobility service platform with the largest user base and operational records.
Responsibilities
In this role, you will build and operate a design system for mobility services and perform UI design responsibilities.
■ Design System
Designing mobility service design guidelines, UI components, patterns, and documentation
Systematizing collaboration processes with the development team to ensure consistent operation and continuous improvement of the design system
■ Mobility Service UI Design
Conducting user-centered UI design and prototyping based on understanding mobility service characteristics
Collecting and analyzing qualitative and quantitative data to verify usability and propose improvement strategies
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in design or related discipline
Minimum 5 years of experience in UI design
Experience in building design systems
Proficiency in using Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator
Preferred Qualifications
Understanding of AI technology and experience with AI-related projects
Others
